entities.summary: Newsmax TV is an American television channel owned by Newsmax described as conservative, pro-Trump, right-wing, and far-right. The network primarily focuses on political opinion-based talk shows. It carries a news/talk format throughout the day and night, with documentaries and films on weekends.
